title: The Battle for Fort Snowhawk (Stormcloaks)
description: Galmar Stone-Fist dispatches Stormcloak forces to seize Fort Snowhawk from Imperial control. Join the attacking soldiers, defeat the Imperial defenders, and secure Hjaalmarch for the Stormcloaks.

base_facts: I am Galmar Stone-Fist, Ulfric Stormcloak's right hand and military commander.
I coordinate the Stormcloak military campaigns across Skyrim.
Fort Snowhawk must be taken to secure Hjaalmarch for the true sons and daughters of Skyrim.

RECEIVE_ORDERS: I have sent the Dragonborn to assist our soldiers in taking Fort Snowhawk.
FORT_CAPTURED: Fort Snowhawk has fallen. Hjaalmarch is ours. Report to Ulfric for the next phase.

base_facts: I am Sorli the Builder. I will serve Hjaalmarch as Jarl once the Imperials are driven out.

FORT_CAPTURED: With Fort Snowhawk taken, I am the new Jarl of Hjaalmarch. The old court has been exiled to the Blue Palace.

beats.comment: Galmar gives orders to assist the Stormcloak attack on Fort Snowhawk.
Player joins the Stormcloak soldiers and begins the assault on Fort Snowhawk.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player joins the Stormcloak soldiers and begins the assault on Fort Snowhawk.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player joins the Stormcloak soldiers and begins the assault on Fort Snowhawk.

beats.comment: Imperials defeated at Fort Snowhawk. Quest completes. Sorli becomes Jarl; Idgrod's court is exiled. Return to Ulfric for Liberation of Skyrim.
